A skincare gift set takes the guesswork out of buying for someone else: the products are chosen to be used together, and the box is ready to give. Here are the skincare gift sets and hair care sets we stock from Vilvah and Deyga, sorted by who they suit, with exactly what is inside each one. Swansura is an official UK partner of both brands, and every kit ships from the UK.

Face care gift sets

  • Vilvah Skin Hydration Kit: Milk Face Toner (earth marine water, glycerine, rice milk extract and glycolic acid) and Milk Drops Serum (aloe vera juice, betaine and hyaluronic acid). A simple two-step routine for after cleansing.
  • Vilvah Everyday Care Milk Kit: the same toner and serum plus Melt-in-Milk Sunscreen SPF 50, so it covers a full morning routine.
  • Vilvah Milk Face Kit: Milk Mud Mask (kaolin, oat milk, saffron and liquorice root extracts) and Milk Drops Serum. A weekly mask and a daily serum.
  • Deyga Healthy Glow Kit: a Rose & Mulethi face pack (dried rose petals, mulethi root and oatmeal, mixed with water or toner) and Rose Water Toner. A good face set for someone who likes traditional ingredients.

The Milk Face Toner contains glycolic acid, so it suits someone who already uses a toner; patch test first and wear SPF in the day. For more on the serum, see our Vilvah Milk Drops guide.

Body care gift sets

  • Vilvah Milk Body Kit: Goat Milk Body Wash (goat milk, coconut-derived cleansers, glycerine and acai oil, scented with vanilla and white lily) and Milk Body Lotion (oat milk, ceramide NP, olive squalane, jojoba and coconut oils). A complete shower-to-moisturiser gift.
  • Vilvah Foot Cream & Body Lotion Kit: Foot Care Cream 100ml (shea, mango and avocado butters with argan and kalonji oils) and Milk Body Lotion 250ml. Ideal for someone with dry skin in winter.
  • Vilvah Deo Shot Kit: two pocket-size solid deodorant balms, Rose & Vanilla and Lavender & Sage, with kaolin clay and vitamin E.

Lip care gift sets

  • Deyga Nourished Lip Care Kit: Strawberry Lip Scrub (sugar in plant oils and shea butter) and the classic Beetroot Lip Balm pot.
  • Deyga Beetroot Lip Balm Stick & Strawberry Lip Scrub combo: the same scrub with the tinted beetroot stick.
  • Vilvah Tinted Lip Balm Kit: the Cream Bun and Mango Milkshake lip balms, each with a hint of colour.
  • Vilvah x Annapoorna Gift Box: Filter Kaapi and Rose Milk lip balms with Annapoorna coffee beans: two Coimbatore names in one box.

Our lip balm guide and beetroot lip balm guide compare them in more detail.

Hair care gift sets

  • Vilvah Bestseller Hair Kit: Goat Milk Shampoo (goat milk, jasmine flower water and hydrolysed pea protein) and Cream Conditioner (tucuma butter, broccoli seed oil and aloe vera).
  • Vilvah Goat Milk Hair Kit: Goat Milk Shampoo with the Goat Milk Hair Mask, for a weekly treat.
  • Deyga Daily Use Healthy Hair Combo: Rice Water Shampoo and Soy Milk Conditioner (soybean extract, argan oil, panthenol and vitamin E).

See our natural shampoo guide for how they compare.

Skincare gifts under £20

For stockings and Secret Santa: the Deyga hair combo, Vilvah Tinted Lip Balm Kit, Deo Shot Kit and Deyga Healthy Glow Kit. Our stocking fillers guide has more ideas.

A premium pick

The Highborn London Ultimate Day & Night Moisture Set holds the Imperial Moisturiser and Night Elixir, both in 50ml jars.

How to choose

  • Not sure of their skin type? Body, lip and hair sets are the safest choice.
  • Check the ingredients: the Deyga beetroot lip balms contain almond oil and beeswax, and the Vilvah goat milk products are not vegan. Every product page has the full ingredient list.
  • Spend £40 or more for free UK delivery.
  • Delivery before Christmas: see our delivery page for dispatch times and rates.

Shop every skincare gift set, or browse Vilvah and Deyga. Buying perfume too? See our Christmas gift guide.

The best stocking fillers are small things she will actually use: a mini of a perfume she loves, a lip balm for her coat pocket, a good soap. Everything in this guide costs under £25, is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, so you can fill a whole stocking from one order. For the full range, see our stocking fillers and gifts under £25.

Designer perfume minis

A miniature is a lovely way to give a designer scent on a small budget, and it fits in a handbag afterwards.

  • Gucci Bloom Parfum 10ml: the richest Bloom, with tuberose and jasmine over vanilla and Peru balsam.
  • Calvin Klein My Euphoria 10ml: blackcurrant, orchid and rose over vanilla and amber, sweet and warm.
  • Marc Jacobs Daisy Love 10ml: cloudberry and daisy over cashmere musk, light and cheerful for daytime.
  • Viktor & Rolf Good Fortune 10ml: fennel and jasmine over bourbon vanilla.
  • Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever 4.5ml and Trussardi Pure Jasmine 7ml: the smallest budgets, still in a proper bottle.
  • Hermès Un Jardin sur le Toit 15ml: apple, pear and rose with a green grass accord.

If she likes to try a few, the Korloff Paris Discovery Set (3 x 10ml) holds three scents in one box. More in travel size and mini perfumes. Our mini perfume sets guide lists what is inside each set.

Lip balms and lip scrubs

Lip care is the classic stocking filler: cheap, useful and welcome in winter.

  • Vilvah Grapefruit Lip Balm: shea butter, avocado and almond oils with a sheer tint and a zesty scent.
  • Vilvah Milk Lip Balm SPF 30 PA+++: mineral filters with shea, soy and kokum butters, for winter walks and ski trips.
  • Deyga Natural Lip Balm: almond oil, jojoba and shea butter, in vanilla or shea.
  • Vilvah Lip Scrub or Deyga Strawberry Lip Scrub: sugar in plant oils and butter to buff away dry flakes.
  • Ready-made pairs: Vilvah Lip Nourishing Kit, a lip scrub and grapefruit balm, and Deyga Soft Lip Combo, a mint lip scrub and beetroot balm.

Our lip scrub guide explains how to use them, our lip balm guide compares SPF, tinted and natural balms, and every balm and scrub is in lip balm and lip care.

Goat milk soaps and bath bars

A handmade soap looks generous wrapped in tissue and costs very little. Vilvah’s goat milk bars are made with farm-fresh goat milk: Classic Rose Goat Milk Soap with rose petals and pink clay, and Classic Goat Milk Soap with lavender essential oil; see them all in goat milk soap, or read our goat milk soap guide. For a fresh morning shower, Cucumber, Curd & Mint Soap is made with curd and mint. From Deyga, the Shea Saffron Bath Bar and Rose Pink Clay Bath Bar are made with raw shea butter and coconut and olive oils.

Small pamper gifts

  • Vilvah Wild Rose Face Mask: three ingredients, aloe vera, French pink clay and rose hydrosol, for a 15-minute Sunday mask.
  • Deyga Foot Butter: coconut oil, olive oil and beeswax with a soft vanilla scent, for feet after a long day in boots. More ideas in our foot cream guide.
  • anatomē Chamomile Bath Salts: natural salts with organic botanicals for a slow evening bath, in a refill pouch or a jar.
  • Vilvah Deo Shot Kit: two pocket-size solid deodorants, Rose & Vanilla and Lavender & Sage. More small kits are in our skincare gift sets guide.

How to fill a stocking for around £50

One perfume mini, one lip balm, one lip scrub and a soap comes to around £50 with the picks above, which also takes the order over £40, so UK delivery is free. For a full bottle, see our women’s perfume under £50 guide. For bigger gifts, read our perfume gift sets guide or the Christmas gift guide.

Good to know

  • Patch test new skincare before first use, especially products with essential oils.
  • Every product is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK. Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga and Vilvah.
  • UK delivery is free on orders over £40, and orders over £70 get £5 off with code SAVE5 at checkout.

A boxed perfume set makes a ready-to-give present, and it does not have to cost much. Every set below was £30 or less at Swansura at the time of writing. Most hold a full bottle plus a matching body lotion, shower gel, deodorant or travel spray; a few hold several small sprays, which is a good choice when you are not sure which scent they would like. We list what is in each box and the notes in each scent, so you can match the set to the person.

How to choose a gift set

  • You know their style: pick a set with a full bottle and a matching body product. The lotion or gel uses the same scent, so they can layer it.
  • You are not sure: pick a set with several small sprays, so they can try more than one scent.
  • For a bag or a trip: pick a travel set with small bottles.

Gift sets for her

  • Trussardi Pure Jasmine Lifestyle Mini Gift Set: a 60ml eau de parfum plus 10ml and 7ml sprays of the same scent. Bergamot, pistachio and neroli, then jasmine and champaca, over vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli. Three sizes means one for home, one for the bag and one for travel.
  • Trussardi Ruby Red Eau de Parfum Gift Set: a 60ml eau de parfum with a 125ml Stardust body emulsion. Citrus and fruit, then rose and jasmine, over amber, vanilla, musk and woods. Warm and polished, a good pick for evenings and the cooler months.
  • Grès Cabotine Rose Gift Set: a 100ml eau de toilette with a 200ml perfumed body lotion. Cherry blossom, pear and green leaves, then peony and mimosa, over plumeria, sandalwood, vetiver and musk. Light and pretty for daytime.
  • Franck Olivier Bella Women Gift Set: a 75ml eau de parfum with a 250ml deodorant. Lemon, lychee and raspberry, then lily and rose, over ambergris, vetiver, cedar and musk.
  • Armaf Club de Nuit Woman Travel Set: two 12ml sprays of the same eau de parfum. Bergamot, grapefruit, peach and orange, then geranium, jasmine, litchi and rose, over musk, patchouli, vanilla and vetiver. One spray for the handbag, one for home. Our Armaf Club de Nuit guide covers the whole line.

Sets with several scents to try

  • Guess Seductive Gift Set: four 15ml eau de toilette sprays, Seductive, Seductive Noir, Seductive Red and Seductive Blue. Seductive is pear and jasmine over vanilla; Noir is iris and lily of the valley over white suede; Red is cherry and almond over tonka; Blue is citrus, cardamom and marine notes over cedarwood and musk.
  • Korloff Paris Discovery Set: three 10ml eau de parfum sprays. The brand describes Miss as fresh and fruity, Lady as floral and elegant, and Korlove as soft and warm.
  • Paco Rabanne Men's Miniature Set: three 4ml eau de toilette minis, 1 Million, Invictus and Phantom. 1 Million is blood mandarin, cinnamon and leather; Invictus is sea notes, grapefruit and bay leaf; Phantom is lemon, lavender and apple over vanilla. Our Paco Rabanne perfume guide compares the full bottles.

Gift sets for him, or for anyone

  • Jaguar Classic Gift Set: a 100ml eau de toilette with a 200ml shower gel. Basil, lavender, mandarin and bergamot, then lotus, orange blossom and ginger, over sandalwood, benzoin and white musk. Listed for men and women.
  • Franck Olivier Black Touch Gift Set: a 100ml eau de toilette with a 250ml deodorant. Cardamom, spices, bergamot and grapefruit, then orange blossom, jasmine and magnolia, over vetiver, patchouli, musk, vanilla and cedar. Also listed for men and women.

For a bigger budget, our perfume gift sets guide covers the designer sets, and our aftershave under £50 guide lists single bottles for him.

Smaller gifts and stocking fillers

A single miniature spray is a lighter present for a stocking. Our mini perfume sets guide lists what is inside each miniature set, and our stocking fillers for her guide adds lip care and soaps.

Delivery

Browse every perfume gift set, or see gift sets for her, aftershave gift sets for him and gifts under £50. All are 100% authentic and ship from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40, so two sets in one order usually ship free. Order early in December so gifts arrive in time; see our shipping policy for delivery options.

articles.before:
A designer perfume for her does not need a big budget. Every women's fragrance below was under £50 at Swansura at the time of writing (for scents sold in more than one size, at least the smallest size is). We have grouped them by mood, with the notes in each, so you can choose one for yourself or as a gift.

Fresh and clean

Citrus, green notes and soft flowers. Easy for every day, the office and warmer weather.

  • Davidoff Cool Water Reborn Intense Eau de Parfum (50ml): bergamot and green notes, then rose, over vetiver, woods and musk.
  • Vera Wang Embrace Green Tea and Pear Blossom (30ml eau de toilette): pear blossom, green tea and bergamot, then freesia, orange blossom and peony, over sandalwood, cedar and musk.
  • Issey Miyake A Drop d'Issey Eau de Parfum Fraîche (90ml): a rain accord, then lilac and Damask rose, over sandalwood and musk. Our L'Eau d'Issey guide compares the Issey Miyake line.
  • Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Eau de Parfum (100ml): citrus, mandarin and bergamot, then jasmine, over cypress, pine and laurel.

Classic florals

Rose, jasmine and white flowers. Polished enough for occasions, gentle enough for daytime.

  • Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum (30ml or 100ml): freesia, mandarin and sage, then lily, carnation, rose and jasmine, over sandalwood, amber and musk. Our Eternity guide compares it with the men's version.
  • Nina Ricci L'Air du Temps Eau de Toilette (30ml or 100ml): carnation, rose, neroli and peach, then jasmine, ylang-ylang, violet and iris, over sandalwood, musk, cedarwood and amber.
  • Lalique L'Amour Eau de Parfum (100ml): bergamot, neroli and rosebuds, then gardenia, tuberose and jasmine, over musk, cedarwood and sandalwood.
  • Elie Saab Le Parfum Eau de Parfum (50ml): orange blossom, then two kinds of jasmine, over cedarwood, patchouli, honey and rose.
  • Chopard Imperiale Iris Malika (100ml eau de parfum): spices and red berries, then iris and jasmine, over vanilla, benzoin and woods. Powdery rather than sweet.

Fruity and sweet

Juicy fruit over vanilla, honey or musk. Cheerful, and a safe pick for someone who likes sweet scents.

  • DKNY Be Delicious Orchard Street (100ml eau de parfum): apple, pink grapefruit and blackcurrant, then jasmine, rose and peony, over musk, cedarwood and amber.
  • Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum (100ml): pear and mandarin, then honeysuckle, orange blossom and peach, over honey, vanilla and woods.
  • Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pure Pétale de Nectar (90ml eau de toilette): pear and honey, then rose and peony, over cashmeran, white musk and sandalwood.
  • Ariana Grande Thank U, Next (100ml eau de parfum): white pear and wild raspberry, then coconut and pink rose, over a macaron note and musk.
  • Lattafa Yara Candy (100ml eau de parfum): green mandarin and blackcurrant, then a strawberry candy accord and gardenia, over vanilla, musk, sandalwood and amber.
  • Arabiyat Prestige Nyla (80ml eau de parfum): coconut, peach, mandarin and bergamot, then tiare, jasmine and rose, over white musk and patchouli.

Warm and for evenings

Spice, amber, musk and moss. Best for colder months, dinners and nights out.

  • Narciso Rodriguez Musc Noir For Her (the 10ml spray is under £50): plum, then musk and heliotrope, over suede. Our Narciso Rodriguez guide has the rest of the line.
  • Paco Rabanne Ultraviolet Eau de Parfum (80ml): pepper, apricot, almond and coriander, then violet, osmanthus, rose and jasmine, over amber, vanilla, patchouli and cedar.
  • Elie Saab Nuit Noor Eau de Parfum (90ml): black pepper and spices, then rose, jasmine and incense, over patchouli, amber, musk and woods.
  • Lalique Satine Eau de Parfum (100ml): jasmine, gardenia and heliotrope, then vanilla, tonka and pink pepper, over patchouli, sandalwood and vetiver.
  • Clinique Aromatics Elixir Eau de Parfum (100ml): rose and orange blossom, then jasmine and ylang-ylang, over patchouli and oakmoss. Rich and mossy rather than sweet.

Which one should you choose?

  • For every day and the office: Calvin Klein Eternity or Davidoff Cool Water Reborn Intense.

Oud perfume does not have to cost three figures. Every scent below is under £60 at Swansura at the time of writing and lists oud (agarwood) in its notes. Most of them are eau de parfum or extrait, so they carry more fragrance than an eau de toilette. We also explain which popular 'oud' names do not list an oud note at all, so you know what you are buying.

What oud smells like

Oud, or agarwood, is a dark, resinous wood note. On its own it can smell smoky, leathery or slightly medicinal, so perfumers usually soften it with rose, saffron, amber or vanilla. Most oud in perfume today is an oud accord rather than pure oud oil. Our oud perfume guide explains this in more detail and covers Tom Ford Oud Wood and Gucci Intense Oud.

Smoky, leathery oud

  • Chopard Oud Malaki (80ml, for men): grapefruit, lavender and artemisia, then tobacco, spices and leather, over oud, ambergris and dark woods. The most polished of the darker ones here.
  • SAP Oud Leopard Extrait de Parfum (100ml, unisex): smoky spice at the top, then oud, leather and cedarwood, over amber, musk and vanilla.
  • Fumeri Oud Saffron for Men (100ml): saffron and spices, then oud, cedarwood and smoky woods, over amber, leather and musk.
  • Dunhill Signature Collection Agar Wood (100ml, for men): pink pepper, ginger and bergamot, then agarwood, saffron and black iris, over tobacco and suede.

Rose and saffron oud

  • Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Royale (75ml, unisex): saffron and rose, then oud and praline, over vanilla, amber and musk. Sweeter and softer than the smoky group.
  • SAP Saffron Oud Extrait de Parfum (100ml, unisex): saffron and warm spices, then oud, cedarwood and smoky woods, over amber, leather and musk.
  • Korloff Royal Oud (88ml, unisex): rose, incense and nutmeg, then oud, patchouli and labdanum, over sandalwood, amber, musk and vanilla.
  • Franck Olivier Sun Java Rose Oud (75ml, unisex): bergamot, orange and blackcurrant, then rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang, over oud, amber, sandalwood and vanilla. A floral rose with oud in the base.

Soft, woody oud

  • Elie Saab La Collection des Essences No. 4 Oud (100ml, unisex): oud with woody accords and spices, over amber, resins and musk. Smooth rather than smoky, so a good first oud.
  • Bentley for Men Absolute (100ml): ginger and pink pepper, then papyrus, sandalwood and olibanum, with oud in the base beside cedarwood and amber. Oud is a background note here.

Names with 'oud' but no oud note

Some well-known scents carry 'oud' in the name but do not list oud in their notes. That does not make them worse; it just means you should choose them for what they do list.

  • The Al Haramain Amber Oud line: Amber Oud Gold Edition is fruity and sweet (melon, pineapple, amber, vanilla) and Amber Oud Tobacco Edition is spicy tobacco with vanilla and cacao. Our Amber Oud editions guide compares every one.
  • Franck Olivier Sun Royal Oud: lemon, then patchouli, rose and white woods, over vanilla.

Which one should you choose?

  • Dark and leathery: Chopard Oud Malaki or SAP Oud Leopard.
  • Rose and saffron: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Royale or Korloff Royal Oud.
  • Your first oud: Elie Saab No. 4 Oud or Franck Olivier Sun Java Rose Oud.
  • Sweet rather than smoky: Shaghaf Oud Royale, or Amber Oud Gold if you want no oud at all.

How to wear oud

Oud is a rich note. It suits cooler months and evenings best. For a warmer, softer trail, our guide to layering oud with body butter shows how. Browse every oud perfume and Arabian perfume we stock, or see gifts under £50. All are 100% authentic and ship from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

anatomē

The London house anatomē makes a collection of eaux de parfum named Balance, Energy, Focus, Order, Expression and Support. Each comes in a smaller size or a larger bottle. Expression is oceanic, Support is herbaceous and green, and Energy is bright and fresh, so they are easy to wear every day.

Niche houses

Hemel's line includes Rosado, a refined rose, and Patchouli For All, rich and sophisticated. Mancera Intense Red Tobacco Extrait is powerful and smoky. Serge Lutens La Fille de Berlin is bold and elegant. Boucheron Rose d'Isparta is a full, elegant rose.

Oud, amber and musk

Guerlain Musc Noble is a smooth musk perfume, and Guerlain Épices Exquises adds warm spice. For oud, Montale Aoud Safran is bold and saffron-rich, and Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition is rich and warm. Al Haramain Detour Noir is a smooth, low-cost way to start.
